mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waitlist (patient_id, patient_name, schedule_id, doctor_id, department_id, schedule_date, period, queue_position, status) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{patientName}, #{scheduleId}, #{doctorId}, #{departmentId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{period}, #{queuePosition}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE waitlist SET patient_id = #{patientId}, patient_name = #{patientName}, schedule_id = #{scheduleId}, doctor_id = #{doctorId}, department_id = #{departmentId}, schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}, period = #{period}, queue_position = #{queuePosition}, status = #{status}, offered_at = #{offeredAt}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, patient_id, patient_name, schedule_id, doctor_id, department_id, schedule_date, period, queue_position, status, offered_at, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM waitlist WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, patient_id, patient_name, schedule_id, doctor_id, department_id, schedule_date, period, queue_position, status, offered_at, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM waitlist WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = #{status}

SELECT id, patient_id, patient_name, schedule_id, doctor_id, department_id, schedule_date, period, queue_position, status, offered_at, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM waitlist WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY queue_position ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, patient_id, patient_name, schedule_id, doctor_id, department_id, schedule_date, period, queue_position, status, offered_at, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM waitlist WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.update: UPDATE waitlist SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
